Traupman 136, 368

1dētumēscit: short u (Traupman 136, 368, printed dētūmēscit). Lewis & Short dētumēscō, a rare word (Statius).

imber dētumēscit1

the rain is letting up

Examples

  • Jam minus pluit; mox exībimus.

    It’s raining less now; we’ll go out soon.composed

See also shower, drop.
